_comment: IAM Policy for CI/CD frontend deployment role.

_permissions_rationale.s3:PutObject: Upload built frontend assets (JS, CSS, HTML) to the S3 bucket.
_permissions_rationale.s3:DeleteObject: Remove stale assets during sync (aws s3 sync --delete).
_permissions_rationale.s3:GetObject: Read existing objects to compute diffs for sync.
_permissions_rationale.s3:ListBucket: List bucket contents to determine which files to sync or delete.
_permissions_rationale.cloudfront:CreateInvalidation: Invalidate the CloudFront cache after upload so users get the new index.html immediately.
